rows.surface: App-owned views, durable request ownership, source staging and MDM export namespace
rows.mechanism: Each controller captures a canonical descriptor; requests and profile views are app-scoped. Legacy Reddit preferences and MDM output are preserved. Inactive Facebook exposes source setup only. Device license, proxies and network fences remain shared. Visible-source archival remains Reddit-only until the daemon archival path is app-scoped.
